description: My 7-inch quadcopter is the flight test platform for MARV V2. I scanned the frame parts at 300 dpi, measured them with calipers, and weighed them individually. Claude Code used the scans to build the parametric SolidCraft assembly and generate a Gazebo model from the same geometry and mass data. I put the measured 914 g all-up weight into the flight simulation model and refined the thrust model with real flight logs. The quad has now flown outdoor hovers, ESKF position hold, and waypoint routes. I’m working on the next sensor stack with LiDAR, a Raspberry Pi 5, and computer vision.
